observations: Photo 0 shows a white box for an Eaton 5E UPS.
The brand 'EATON' is clearly visible in blue text at the top left of the box.
The model 'EATON 5E' is printed below the brand name.
The box includes multilingual text describing the product's purpose: protecting IT, multimedia, and internet equipment.
Icons on the box indicate features: AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulation), 2 years warranty, USB, and Silent operation.
An image of the UPS unit is shown on the right side of the box — it is a dark gray, rectangular device with a front panel and ventilation grilles.
The box appears to be new and unopened, with no visible damage.
A watermark 'MEGATECH COMPUTERS LTD' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a new, sealed Eaton 5E UPS box with official branding and features. The presence of a 2-year warranty and multilingual official text supports the claim of originality.

risks.risk: The UPS may be counterfeit or reboxed despite the official-looking packaging.
risks.proof: A close-up of the serial number or barcode on the box, and a photo of the actual unit's label with model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially counterfeit, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The unit may be damaged or non-functional despite the box appearing new.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box, showing the front and back panels, and a video of it powering on and displaying status lights.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, since unverified 'works' is treated as failure.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box, showing front and back.
Close-up of the serial number and barcode on the box and on the unit.
Video of the UPS powering on and showing status lights.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Eaton 5E UPS from the box, and the seller's claim of originality is supported by the packaging. However, without seeing the actual unit or verifying serial numbers, there is a risk of counterfeit or non-functional product. The price cannot be set until these risks are mitigated.
